metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the tool in `output/` with no third-party dependencies. The CLI entrypoint is [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp), the MARC/ISO2709/MARCXML logic is in [marc.cpp](/workspace/output/marc.cpp), and the embedded MARC field rules are in [marc_rules_data.h](/workspace/output/marc_rules_data.h). Build config is [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt).

Build verified with `cd /workspace/output && cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. I also ran all four actions end to end and checked structured error handling for invalid canonical input, invalid UTF-8 in ISO 2709 field payloads, and invalid MARCXML namespace/shape.
